blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) monitored 8,480 passengers traveling in Southern Tagalog ports during six hours on Friday as authorities intensified security measures for the All Saints’ Day weekend rush. The Coast Guard District Southern Tagalog recorded 4,107 outbound passengers and 4,373 inbound passengers from midnight to 6 a.m. on Friday, according to its port monitoring report. During the same period, Coast Guard personnel inspected 38 vessels, including 30 roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) vessels. No motor bancas were inspected.
